definitions.tool_round: Unique assistant message.id containing one or more tool_use blocks; not SDK num_turns.
definitions.volume: Sum Unicode code points and UTF-8 bytes of tool_result content text only; excludes duplicate tool_use_result metadata, JSON framing, assistant prose/thinking and usage counters. Not tokens or price.
definitions.read_repetition: Exact frozen-source path/line pairs returned by more than one Read; each later occurrence counted once.
definitions.curated_coverage: Conservative first evidence-set, full-line coverage diagnostic. Valid equivalent or partial evidence may support correct reasoning; missing a full span is not a quality failure.

observations: The single treatment search uses the correct /workspace root, resolves successfully, and reports fts+vector matches. The run records no wrong-root or unresolved treatment search.

MCP rank 6 points directly to segment.cc flush (advertised 2217–2324; actual preview 2217–2226 includes the null-or-no-record WAL guard). Rank 8 points to the frozen crash recovery test; rank 13 points to collection recovery. No MCP hit advertises the SegmentImpl::recover body around 4193–4301.
The treatment follows search with direct source reads and Grep. It uses fewer total calls, but more Read calls and more returned tool text; this is consistent with its higher cumulative input usage.

Small repeated Read overlaps exist in the treatment at segment.cc:4280–4284, segment.cc:2200–2204 and collection.cc:969. Most treatment Read volume is unique source lines rather than repeated reading.

The treatment reaches the conservative full curated C1–C3 source bundle by call 16. The baseline does not return the full curated E01 span. This does not establish that either answer understood or cited the causal chain correctly.
limitations: One baseline-first pair; no causal attribution to embedding model and no stable benefit/generalization claim.
Tool-result delivery and source-span coverage are retrieval diagnostics, not answer-quality scores.
No contemporaneous local-embedding arm exists in this pair; comparing historical runs cannot isolate embedding effects.
matchedBy=fts+vector is the native result annotation, not an independent measurement of vector contribution or ranking causality.
